title: Forcing Effects on Finite-Time Blow-Up in Degenerate and Singular Parabolic Equations
summary: We study the degenerate and singular parabolic equation with a forcing term \[ |x|^{σ_1}u_t = Δu + |x|^{σ_2}|u|^p + t^\varrho \mathbf{w}(x), \quad (t,x)\in(0,\infty)\times\mathbb{R}^N, \] where $N\ge 2$, $σ_1,σ_2>-2$, $\varrho>-1$, $p>1$, and $\mathbf{w}\in L^1(\mathbb{R}^N)$ is continuous. We establish critical exponents that sharply separate the regimes of global existence and finite-time blow-up. For $\varrho>0$, we prove that there is no weak global solution for all $p>1$.
